description: Estimate capital gains tax on one asset sale for a resident individual in Australia or Finland. AU (the default): the gain is taxed at the marginal rate on top of other income — pass income and heldMoreThan12Months; capital losses apply before the 50% discount for assets held over 12 months, per ATO ordering. FI: capital income tax of 30%, or 34% above 30 000 € of capital income, on the gain after the better of the actual cost or the deemed acquisition cost (hankintameno-olettama: 20% of the price, 40% after 10 years), with the 1 000 € small-disposals rule — pass yearsHeld, and otherCapitalIncome if there is any. Use it for share, property or crypto sales; for pay without an asset sale use income_tax_estimate. Other countries' CGT is not covered and returns an error. The main-residence exemptions and non-resident rules are out of scope.

capitalLosses.description: Capital losses to offset — AU: before any discount; FI: from this year or carried forward (five years)

costBase.description: What the asset cost, in local currency. AU: the cost base including eligible incidental costs. FI: the acquisition price (pass buying and selling costs as saleExpenses)

heldMoreThan12Months.description: AU: true when the asset was held over 12 months, which halves the taxable gain (the 50% CGT discount). Required for AU

income.description: AU: other taxable income for the year in AUD (salary etc.) — sets the marginal rate the gain stacks on. Required for AU

otherCapitalIncome.description: FI: other capital income this year (dividends, rent, other gains) — decides how much of the gain falls above the 30 000 € threshold

proceeds.description: Sale price of the asset, in local currency

saleExpenses.description: FI: brokerage, fees and other costs of buying and selling

taxYear.description: FI: calendar tax year like '2026'; omit for the current year

totalProceedsThisYear.description: FI: the year's total sale prices, this sale included, for the 1 000 € small-disposals rule; omit when this is the only sale

yearsHeld.description: FI: whole years owned — 10 or more raises the deemed acquisition cost from 20% to 40% of the price

name: cgt_estimate

cgtPayable.description: Extra tax caused by the gain, in local currency

costDeducted.description: FI: the cost deducted from the price

dataVerifiedOn.description: ISO date the rate data was last confirmed against the authority

disclaimer.description: General-information note that must accompany any figure shown to a person

discountApplied.description: AU: whether the 50% discount halved the taxable gain. Always false for FI, which has no discount

grossGain.description: AU: proceeds minus cost base. FI: proceeds minus the larger of actual or deemed cost. Floored at 0, local currency

loss.description: FI: the loss on this sale, if any (only ever from the actual cost)

lossDeductible.description: FI: whether that loss can be deducted

mayBeStale.description: True once the verification date is over a year old — re-confirm with the authority

method.description: FI: whether the actual cost or the deemed acquisition cost was deducted

notes.description: FI: rules that decided the answer, in plain words

smallDisposalsExempt.description: FI: true when the year's sale prices total 1 000 € or less, making every gain tax-free

source.description: The national tax authority the figures were verified against (e.g. 'ATO — ato.gov.au')

sourceUrl.description: https link to the authority page the rate was verified against. Present only on rate answers backed by a verified ledger row — absent (never empty) otherwise, so its presence is itself the claim

taxYear.description: Tax year whose rules were used

taxableGain.description: Gain the tax was charged on

title: Capital gains tax estimate (AU, FI)
